name: readlink
description: Read a symbolic link. Returns { target }: on POSIX the raw stored target (a relative target stays relative); on Windows the fully resolved final path of a symlink or junction (GetFinalPathNameByHandle). A path that is not a link answers `EINVAL: not a symbolic link`. Additive action: an older host answers NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: The link; relative paths resolve against the host cwd.
